program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((mapping (make-hash)))
    (let loop ([c 0])
      (when (< (+ c 1) (cols g))
        (if (and (not (= (at g 0 c) 0)) (not (= (at g 0 (+ c 1)) 0)))
            (begin (hash-set! mapping (at g 0 c) (at g 0 (+ c 1))) (loop (+ c 2)))
            (loop (+ c 1)))))
    (grid-from-fn (- (rows g) 1) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((v (at g (+ r 1) c)))
          (hash-ref mapping v v))))))
